articles.title: NHS 'will collapse' without social care reform, PM tells BBC
articles.description: The prime minister says he would not want to leave office without bringing in "substantial change" to the social care system.

articles.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
articles.description: Police say Abdul Ballout was shot and killed after he rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin.

articles.title: TV presenter and comedian Bill Oddie dies at 85
articles.description: His agent pays tribute to the "multi-talented" broadcaster, comedian and conservationist.

articles.title: Girlguiding unveils first major redesign of uniform range since 1990
articles.description: Under the new rules, members will be able to wear a top from the new range with their own trousers.
